title: ROW_NUMBER
seoDescription: Assign deterministic per-segment activity ranks with SQL ROW_NUMBER ordered by engagement score and username.
description:
Assign sequential integers to rows within each partition segment ordered by score descending and username ascending.

ROW_NUMBER produces distinct ascending integers within partitions without gaps, unlike RANK or DENSE_RANK.

### Query Logic & Formulation
$$
\operatorname{ROW\_NUMBER}() \quad \text{OVER}(\operatorname{PARTITION BY} \text{segment\_id} \quad \operatorname{ORDER BY} \text{score DESC, username ASC})
$$

### Relational Execution Steps
1. Partition records by segment_id
2. Sort records within each partition by score descending with username breaking ties
3. Assign sequential 1-based ranks to each row

### Expected Query Output
List of records including the computed rank.
